stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 5 of the selection "Trees Rise in the Desert."  

Slowly over the years, many of those who laughed at their neighbor have now joined him.
instruction: Which sentence from the selection "A Legacy of Stone" illustrates a similar idea?

options.label: A
options.text: Forty-three-year-old Cheval continued collecting stones along his route for almost 20 years. (paragraph 4)

options.label: B
options.text: At night he labored by the light of an oil lamp. (paragraph 5)

options.label: C
options.text: But as his palace took shape, people’s criticisms were replaced by awed respect. (paragraph 6)

options.label: D
options.text: Cheval’s uniqueness helped him single-handedly create a marvel beyond duplication. (paragraph 9)

visual_elements: Slowly over the years, many of those who laughed at their neighbor have now joined him.
